name: math-skill
description: 面向 AI 架构创新与密码学研究的数学研究路由器：15 个思想透镜、33 个共用数学锚点、4 个密码学锚点、22 个 AI 设计原型，以及渐进加载、Domain Router 与 Knowledge Gap Protocol。Math research router for AI architecture and cryptography with progressive loading, domain isolation, and explicit token budgets.
author: the-thinker0

scripts.validate: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),cp=require('child_process');if(fs.existsSync('tests/validate.sh'))process.exit(cp.spawnSync('bash',['tests/validate.sh'],{stdio:'inherit'}).status||0);if(fs.existsSync('tests/validate.ps1'))process.exit(cp.spawnSync('powershell',['-ExecutionPolicy','Bypass','-File','tests/validate.ps1'],{stdio:'inherit'}).status||0);console.log('tests/ not available in published package');"
scripts.validate:sh: test -f tests/validate.sh && bash tests/validate.sh || echo 'tests/ not available in published package'
scripts.validate:win: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "if (Test-Path tests/validate.ps1) { & tests/validate.ps1 } else { Write-Host 'tests/ not available in published package' }"
